thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected for preproc.tokenize in us-west-2. p95=0.62s (SLO 0.5s), p99=1.82s (SLO 1.0s) over the last 5m. Streaming stalls also spike for long-running responses. Paging oncall: @oncall-sre-rita

oncall-sre-rita: on it. grabbing initial metrics + will kick off an incident channel. tagging SRE and preproc eng.

sre-alex: can you paste the p95/p99 time series and the affected routes? need to know customer impact ASAP.

eng-preproc-maya: attaching quick findings: over the last 10m the increase aligns with a spike in requests that hit JSON-mode prompt parsing + large tool schema expansions. p95 climbed first then p99 shot up when streaming sessions persisted. sample queries:
```
# prometheus-ish psuedo queries
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(preproc_tokenize_duration_seconds_bucket{region="us-west-2"}[5m])) by (le))
rate(preproc_tokens_processed_total{route=~"/v1/chat.*"}[5m])
```
raw numbers: p95 0.62s, p99 1.82s, median ~0.12s. CPU on preproc JVMs hit 85-95% and GC pauses visible.

eng-runtime-jose: streaming tail consumers show long ack delays. Likely tokenizer blocking the preproc worker threadpool used for streaming chunking. saw `stream.tail.write_delay` climb to 3-4s for a subset of calls.

support-lee: customers reporting intermittent slow streaming for chat completions (two enterprise customers). one opened a ticket, one reported degraded UX. estimating ~0.5% of sessions affected in us-west-2.

eng-preproc-maya: probable root: some prompt templates include expanding tool schemas (JSON-mode) into the prompt at request-time which creates massive tokenization cost and regex parsing per request. this gets worse with streaming when we still tokenize whole prompt up front for schema validation.

pm-olivia: what's the customer-visible mitigation we can apply quickly? can we toggle JSON-mode off per-route?

eng-preproc-maya: yep we have a per-route feature flag. two fast mitigations: 1) temporarily disable JSON-mode for high-traffic chat routes in us-west-2, 2) scale preproc replicas / increase threadpool to drain existing backlog. longer term: move tool-schema expansion to background cache + prefix caching.

oncall-sre-rita: I'm going to flip the flag for prod chat routes in us-west-2 and also scale preproc pool by +30% for now.

oncall-sre-rita: running command:
```
redwoodctl config set-route --region us-west-2 --route "/v1/chat" --preproc.json_mode=false --reason "mitigate p99 tokenize spike"
redwoodctl cluster scale --service preproc --region us-west-2 --delta +3
```

deploy-bot: config change applied: set-route succeeded (change-id: cfg-89a2). scaling started: preproc replica set scaling +3 (target healthy 12 -> 15).

incident-bot: NOTE: after mitigations p99 dropped to ~0.95s within 90s, p95 back to 0.48s. streaming tail write_delay median down to ~200ms.

sre-alex: good. please keep monitoring for 15m and capture any remaining offending request ids. also capture one sample request body that triggered the heavy expansion for postmortem.

eng-runtime-jose: adding a temporary route-level timeout bump for streaming writers to avoid client perceived stalls while backpressure drains: `stream.write_timeout=10s` for the route.

support-lee: drafting customer impact message: 
- Window: 2026-02-15T08:01 - 08:14 UTC
- Region: us-west-2
- Symptom: intermittent slow streaming and increased completion latencies for chat endpoints (p99 up to ~1.8s)
- Customers affected: small subset (est. 0.5% sessions), 2 reported tickets
Will post to customers by EOD after confirmation.

eng-preproc-maya: root cause notes to record: naive in-request expansion of large tool schemas + JSON-mode validation triggers expensive tokenization + regex/parse work. exacerbated by streaming path doing eager tokenization for schema checks. fixes: cache expanded schema per-route, do lazy validation for streaming, and add a guard for template expansion size. creating internal ticket.

eng-preproc-maya: creating ticket INC-2125 (preproc) -> title: "Eager tool-schema expansion in JSON-mode causing tokenizer tail spikes". will include sample request ids, flamegraphs, GC traces.

pm-olivia: please add customer-facing summary and any follow-up action that might affect contracts (SLA credits?). I'll coordinate comms if necessary.

support-lee: posted internal customer note draft to #customer-notes for review.

oncall-sre-rita: handing over to @sre-alex for overnight monitoring. my shift ends in 30m. current status: mitigations applied, p99 ~0.95s, no new customer escalations in last 10m.

sre-alex: taking over. I'll keep alerting on and will escalate to eng if p99 creeps back >1.2s. adding a short-term alert rule to catch regressions: `when p99(preproc.tokenize)>1.2s for 3m -> page oncall`

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity: Sev3 -> TBD if follow-up finds broader impact. Incident channel will remain open for postmortem notes.

eng-preproc-maya: next steps: implement schema expansion cache + lazy JSON-mode path (PR planned), add unit tests for template size limits, rollout plan to canary in us-west-2 then global.

pm-olivia: thanks all. good mitigation. please link PR/INC-2125 to the postmortem and assign owners.

oncall-sre-rita: final note before handoff: saved heap & GC traces at `/var/ops/incidents/2125678901/` and uploaded to S3 `s3://redwood-incidents/2125678901/` for eng debugging.

sre-alex: acknowledged. taking it from here.
